messages:
mira (Design): sketch uploaded -> https://img.redwood.example/ux/heatmap-burst-annot.png

mira (Design): thinking about adding a subtle vertical 'burst' marker overlay on the heatmap + p95 sparkline when throughput exceeds a rolling threshold (e.g., 3x baseline) so users can quickly spot burst periods. also wondering if the legend needs a tiny label for these markers. thoughts on visual weight & copy? :thinking_face:

alex (Eng UI): I like the idea. my only worry is visual noise if bursts are frequent. could we make markers aggregate (collapsed) when many in the same bucket? maybe a dot + count?

mira (Design): yep, aggregation is what i sketched — a thin keyline with a pill when >1 in same time bin. default color: #ff9f43 (warn) on dark bg, stroke 1px. hover shows list of burst events.

juan (Product): question: is burst about throughput only or latency spikes too? product teams will interpret differently. might be worth calling it "throughput burst" in the legend rather than just "burst".

mira (Design): good call — prefer explicit copy. proposal for legend entry: "Throughput bursts (roll. >3x)". short tooltip: "Periods where requests/sec jumped significantly"

sam (Eng Runtime): from infra side we can emit a burst flag in the observability stream. two caveats: 1) need consistent bin alignment with heatmap sampling windows, 2) beware perf when rendering heavy overlays for realtime streams. aggregation helps.

alex (Eng UI): accessibility nit: the current keyline contrast on dark theme is borderline. with #ff9f43 we pass normal text contrast but might fail for WCAG UI components. can we add a 2px glow or increase alpha? test with color-blind filters too.

mira (Design): yea i can up the contrast. suggestion: add 1px outer glow using multiply; fallback for a11y mode -> solid #ff6d00. also add an aria-label on the marker: `aria-label="Throughput burst: high request rate"`

aria-bot: accessibility check: recommended contrast ratio >= 3:1 for interactive indicators. If using glow, ensure indicator has text alternative (tooltip + aria) for screen readers.

sam (Eng Runtime): also: sampling implications — if heatmap uses 1% sampling, small bursts might disappear. product should decide min-sampling for burst detection or we compute burst on unsampled telemetry and include a separate burst stream.

juan (Product): leaning toward computing burst on full telemetry and emitting a separate lightweight stream (burst events) so UX is reliable regardless of heatmap sampling. costs look manageable.

alex (Eng UI): copy tweak: "Throughput bursts (roll. >3x)" is fine but too terse in tooltip. propose: "Throughput bursts — periods where request rate abruptly increases relative to recent baseline."

mira (Design): agree. final legend copy: "Throughput bursts — periods where request rate abruptly increases vs recent baseline". small pill label -> "n bursts". hover shows table: timestamp, peak RPS, duration, sample confidence.

sam (Eng Runtime): for sample confidence we can expose an integer 0-100 computed from sampled ratio. will wire.

alex (Eng UI): implementation detail: when multiple markers collide with p95 sparkline markers, ensure z-order keeps burst markers behind the p95 line. also add reduced-opacity state when disabled in legend.

mira (Design): noted. UX question: should bursts be enabled by default? my gut: yes for first-run, but with an onboarding tooltip explaining what they mean. product?

juan (Product): enable by default for new users; persist toggle in preferences. add a brief in-console explainer (1 sentence + learn more link).

mira (Design): ok i'll update mocks: - aggregated burst pill - legend entry + tooltip copy - a11y color fallback - onboarding microcopy

alex (Eng UI): small CSS snippet for the fallback state i tested: ```css
.burst-marker { stroke: #ff9f43; filter: drop-shadow(0 0 2px rgba(255,159,67,0.6)); }
.burst-marker.a11y { stroke: #ff6d00; filter: none; }
```

mira (Design): perfect, will include that in the spec. i'll also add an acceptance criteria list for design: - burst markers render in aggregated form at low zoom - tooltip shows required fields - aria-label & keyboard focusable - legend toggles state persisted

sam (Eng Runtime): i'll add an RFC for the telemetry side and estimate perf impact. expect a tiny overhead but doable.

mira (Design): thanks all — i'll push updated frames to the Figma file and ping when ready. :sparkles: 

alex (Eng UI): :thumbsup:

juan (Product): sgty, thanks!
